text:
grace: Nightly eval alert: legal_faqs int8 run shows a 6x bump in 'fabricated citations' failures starting ~03:00 UTC. @omar can you take a look? eval-bot attached diff.

eval-bot: nightly-eval | model: redwood-llama-7b-int8-wrapup | suite: legal_faqs | failure_rate: 12% -> 72% | anomaly_score: 8.3 | artifacts: s3://redwood-nightlies/1897543210/diff.json

omar: on it. which runtime/config was used for that canary? the int8-wrapup with fused kernels or the stable quant profile?

grace: int8-wrapup + custom kernel set "fused-kv-v2" from the runtime deploy rolled to canary at ~02:45.

marta: i skimmed a couple failing outputs — many are long-context Qs where the model invents court citations mid-answer. also saw token repeats around token ~130.

ci-bot: deploy: runtime v3.4.7 -> v3.4.8 canary (fused-kv-v2) by jack @02:41 UTC :information_source:

omar: pulling samples now. link: s3://redwood-nightlies/1897543210/samples/seed123.jsonl

jack: repro locally w/ int8-wrapup on a1-large shows injected strings like "See Doe v. State, 2003" at the same step across seeds. looks like KV alignment issue when sequence crosses 128->129 boundary.

sanjay: could be attention mask or positional encoding offset introduced by fused-kv-v2. any positional index changes in the patch?

grace: failing sample (trimmed):
```
Q: What precedent applies to landlord negligence in property disputes?
A: The leading case is Doe v. State, 2003, 48 F.3d 123 (Fict. Cir. 2003). The court held that...
```
These citations are fabricated — not in our ground truth.

marta: i dumped kv_cache for that run and compared v3.4.7 vs v3.4.8 for the same prompt. i see a one-step shift in KV keys starting at step 9 (0-indexed).

omar: can we rollback the canary to v3.4.7? nightly uses canary runtime for evals so it would stop the noisy alerts.

jack: rolling back now. @ci-bot start rollback to v3.4.7 :arrow_forward:

ci-bot: rollback complete: canary restored to v3.4.7 at 03:10 UTC

eval-bot: scheduled re-run triggered. rerun ETA ~20m; results will post here.

grace: if rerun fixes it, we still need a postmortem and tests: KV alignment parity check in quant path + targeted prompt set for invented-citations.

sanjay: i'll add a unit test that compares kv_cache hashes between stable and canary on a few long-context seeds and add a check into nightly harness. will open PR shortly.

marta: pushed a small repro script: repo/eng-ml/kv-repro/1897543210.sh and a kv-diff log at s3://redwood-nightlies/1897543210/kv-diff.txt

omar: thanks all — keeping thread open until rerun green. :eyes:

grace: assigning followups: @sanjay add unit test, @marta write postmortem draft, @jack coordinate release blockers. i'll start the incident ticket.

jack: noted. will also revert fused-kv-v2 change and run internal stress tests on int8 path.

ci-bot: ticket created: IN-1897543210 — nightly-eval: legal_faqs fabricated citations spike (assigned: marta, sanjay, jack)

omar: quick note — this matches a smaller drift we saw in a local quant sweep last month but we didn't hit the long-context trigger. good catch by nightly harness.

grace: closing loop when rerun passes. thanks everyone. :heart:
